keyword_groups.reason: Core domain action for user authentication flow
Primary entity being authenticated in the login context

group_logic.reason: Login handling function must lexically contain both 'login' and 'user' (or synonyms) in its identifier or signature

intention.intent_statement: Does this function serve as the primary entry point for verifying user credentials and establishing an authenticated session?
intention.description: Function must implement the initial, externally triggered logic that receives login request and orchestrates credential validation

relation.description: Function must be an entrypoint: no incoming calls (in_degree = 0) and at least one outgoing call (out_degree > 0), indicating it is invoked from outside the application logic (e.g., HTTP route, CLI command)
